items.job: Replace dual clutch assembly and input shaft seals
items.note: Ford's past clutch warranty extensions have mostly ended, but ask a dealer to check your VIN. Clutches may wear out again.

items.job: Replace and program transmission control module
items.note: Ford extended TCM coverage to 10 years/150,000 miles on many cars. Check your VIN with a dealer; coverage may have run out.

items.t: Stalling after refueling or crushed fuel tank
items.job: Replace canister purge valve and update engine software
items.note: Covered by a Ford recall; check your VIN. If the fuel tank is crushed, tank replacement adds a lot.

items.t: Door won't latch or bounces open
items.note: Price is per door. Covered by Ford door latch recalls; check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Valve seat can drop into the cylinder
items.job: Replace cylinder head (or engine if cylinder is damaged)
items.note: Upper end assumes a used or rebuilt engine when the piston and cylinder are damaged.

items.t: Key will not turn in the ignition
items.note: Keys may need to be matched or reprogrammed.

items.t: Engine vibration from a worn top engine mount
Rear wheel bearings wear out early
Rear door may not latch fully and can open (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 05V-030. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Clogged in-tank fuel filter can stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 03V-482. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Battery cables can short and overheat (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 02V-288. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear wheel hub nuts can loosen (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 00V-303. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Cruise control cable can hold the throttle open (recalls)
items.note: Free under recall 00V-302. Check the VIN first. Also see 99V-346.

items.t: Front suspension pinch bolts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Replace front ball joint pinch bolts
items.note: Free under recall 02V-289. Check the VIN first.
